## Nature of the problem

- [ ] Factually wrong
- [ ] Internally contradictory — two clauses disagree
- [ ] Ambiguous — could reasonably be read two ways that imply different code
- [ ] Missing — a decision was made but never written down
- [ ] Typo, spelling or formatting
